_comment: Real routes confirmed from /api/v1/openapi.json on 2026-08-20. No 'auth' block: Keycloak's healthdoc-frontend client has directAccessGrantsEnabled=false and healthdoc-backend is bearerOnly, so this script cannot authenticate as-is without editing realm-healthdoc.json, which is out of scope here. Scenarios below are limited to unauthenticated /ping and /health endpoints as a result — this proves the server survives 50 concurrent connections, not that the 5 clinical journeys hold up under load. Note that gap explicitly in the PR.
